Admin routes of the settings module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/settings

Get all settings grouped by section

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## PATCH /v1/admin/settings

Update one or more settings

Request body: [UpdateSettingsDto](#updatesettingsdto).

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/settings/locales

Get supported locales and default locale

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## PATCH /v1/admin/settings/locales

Update supported locales and default locale

Request body: [UpdateLocalesDto](#updatelocalesdto).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## Schemas

### BaseColorsDto

- `primary` (string, pattern `HEX_COLOR`, required).
- `secondary` (string, pattern `HEX_COLOR`, nullable, required).
- `accent` (string, pattern `HEX_COLOR`, nullable, required).

### CurrencyConfigDto

- `code` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{3}$/`, required).
- `symbol` (string, max length 8, optional).
- `decimalPlaces` (number, min 0, max 3, optional).

### SettingsTranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, max length 500, required).

### UpdateLocalesDto

- `supportedLocales` (array of string, required).
- `defaultLocale` (string, required).
- `rtlLocales` (array of string, optional).
